skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 90% ATK(+10) DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 110% ATK(+10) DMG to each enemy in the entire row, and has a 100% chance to reduce DMG taken by self by 10% for 2 turns.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 110% ATK(+10) DMG to each enemy in the entire row, and has a 100% chance to reduce DMG taken by self by 20% for 2 turns.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases self HP by (+20). When deployed alongside Eyelashes, increases DMG by 20% until the end of battle.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases self HP by (+20). When deployed alongside Eyelashes, increases DMG by 30% until the end of battle.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases self HP by (+20). When deployed alongside Eyelashes, increases DMG by 35% until the end of battle.
